facts.business: SJVN Limited is a central public sector enterprise engaged in hydroelectric power generation, solar power, wind power, and thermal power through its subsidiaries, with core operations in hydroelectric projects like Nathpa Jhakri and Rampur.

capacity_or_capex.item: 1320 MW Buxar Thermal Power Plant (Unit 1: 660 MW)
Etalin HEP (Disposal Group Held for Sale)

auditor.name: M/s Charanjit Singh & Associates, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: (a) Devsari HEP hold with Rs 251.38 crore incurred; (b) Etalin HEP reclassified as held for sale (assets Rs 736.97 crore); (c) Luhri Stage-II HEP provision of Rs 18.03 crore; (d) Pending NJHPS tariff order for 2024-29, provisional billing; (e) Impairment loss of Rs 174.11 crore recognized in FY 2025-26.

key_risks: Regulatory risk due to pending tariff orders (e.g., NJHPS 2024-29)
Project execution risk: Devsari HEP on hold since July 2021
Asset impairment risk: Rs 174.11 crore impairment in FY 2025-26
Project abandonment risk: Etalin HEP reassigned to NHPC, classified as held for sale
Dependence on government policy and approvals for project viability
